source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.foliage: Blue-green, twice evenly pinnate; leaflets sensitive to touch
morphology_source_reported.inflorescence: Short ca. 2 cm heads on erect axillary stalks
morphology_source_reported.flowers: All stamens anther-bearing; ten free stamens with deep yellow filaments; separate petals

habitat_source_reported: Disturbed ground in various soils; some preference for sandy clay
cautions: Source morphology has not been independently corroborated or approved for identification scoring
Regional habitat and distribution do not establish Hays County nativity
